title: Aligning Definition of "Animals" in Two Legislation
what_it_is: Aligning Definition of "Animals" in Two Legislation

sections.label: Animals and Birds Act objectives
sections.summary: The Animals and Birds Act prevents animal disease, controls animal movement, prevents cruelty and safeguards animal welfare, while the Road Traffic Act ensures road user safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The objectives of the two Acts are different.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Animals and Birds Act seeks to prevent the introduction and spread of diseases through animals, control the movement of animals, prevent cruelty to animals, and safeguard the general welfare of animals in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: On the other hand, the primary intent of the Road Traffic Act is to ensure the safety of road users, including motorists, cyclists and pedestrians.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The specific provision in the Road Traffic Act relating to animals had been confined to farm animals of commercial value.

sections.label: Review of animals definition
sections.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs will review the definition of animals in the Road Traffic Act and consider amendments in the context of road safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs intends to review the definition of "animals" in the Road Traffic Act and also consider any amendment in the context of road safety, especially the safety of the motorists and other road users.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In response to the Member's question, yes, we will review.
